prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / targeted pixel-art portrait revision. Image 1 is the portrait to EDIT, images 2-5 are the four style anchors. Do not reproduce the current large bright eye whites or worried eyebrows; those are the defects to fix. Produce exactly one revised isolated portrait. Preserve this person's identity, sex, age, face shape, hairstyle silhouette, head angle and clothing colors. Maintain the extreme close head crop and 74:100 aspect ratio. This is the one targeted quality revision, not a new character.
The current face is recognizable; make the EYES smaller, naturally adult, less cartoon/eyeliner-like. Dark iris/pupil fills nearly the entire eye opening; eye white is only a TINY low-brightness muted warm-gray sliver equivalent to ONE logical pixel or less. No ivory, cream or white eye blocks. Keep a composed, quietly resolute lateral glance, and flatten the brows closer to LEVEL instead of a sharp diagonal angry slash. Maintain the firm closed mouth and quiet sustained indignation; no worried inner-brow arches, pleading, sadness, vengeance snarl or forgiving smile.
Preserve the ONE broad distinctive silver-gray hair streak and compact side braid on viewer-right, but merge the rest of the long parallel fine hair stripes into just 4-6 large connected dark-brown masses with wide stepped highlight planes. Keep her TWENTIES age, adult firm cheek/jaw and youthful smooth skin; the gray streak does not mean old age. Reduce the lower scarf band height so the head/face occupy still more of the image; keep a short neck and only a narrow brown two-fold scarf over charcoal collar at the very bottom.
Keep broad, crisp, hard-edged pixel clusters designed on a 74x100 logical grid. Firm cheekbones, nose wings and adult jaw planes, earth-toned flat ramps, near-black stepped contour, at most 32 logical colors. No antialiasing, smoothing, gradients, dither, speckle, high-frequency texture, glossy highlights or isolated decorative pixels. No added objects, hair ornaments, rank symbols, text, frame, panel, chest, hands or background. True transparent alpha outside the portrait silhouette. Do not change the latest approved costume colors. Preserve the strong facial geometry rather than beautifying or rounding it.
Independent QA emphasis: keep the inner brow ends LOW AND LEVEL, not raised with worry. The mouth is a small almost HORIZONTAL CLOSED line, not a downturned sad mouth. The single gray hair streak must be medium-dark desaturated warm gray, not silver-white. Preserve her twenties age and youthful adult skin. Compress the bare neck and bring the narrow two-fold brown scarf right up beneath the jaw.
